test_title: PYST 80: SSC CGL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following organisations is NOT a winner of the $100,000 cash prize as ‘Best Small Business: Good Food for All’, announced by the United Nations for providing inspiring, diverse and impactful solutions in improving access to

healthy and sustainable food?

options.text: Oorja Development Solutions India Private Limited

solution:
The correct answer is __**Patanjali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Patanjali** is a well-known Indian consumer goods company that was founded by Baba Ramdev and Acharya Balkrishna.
 
• The company is not among the winners of the $100,000 cash prize as 'Best Small Business: Good Food for All' announced by the United Nations.
 
• Patanjali focuses on producing a wide range of products including food, personal care, and health products.
 
• The company's mission is to promote Ayurvedic products and support the traditional Indian system of medicine.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Edible Routes Private Limited**

 
 
• Edible Routes is an organization that promotes urban farming and sustainable agriculture.
 
• They help individuals and communities grow their own food in urban spaces.
 
• Their initiatives are aimed at improving access to healthy and sustainable food.
 
 
 
• **Oorja Development Solutions India Private Limited**
 
 
• Oorja Development Solutions focuses on providing clean energy solutions to underserved communities.
 
• Their projects include solar-powered irrigation systems and other sustainable energy solutions.
 
• They aim to improve agricultural productivity and food security through their energy solutions.
 
 
 
• **Taru Naturals**
 
 
• Taru Naturals is a social enterprise that works with small farmers in India.
 
• They focus on promoting organic and sustainable farming practices.
 
• They help farmers access markets and improve their livelihoods through sustainable agriculture.
